fusions.name: Marking Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks the blade's tip at the first enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 4 damage and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Close the Chase
fusions.desc: A running cut that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Quarry Sighted
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of the Wounded
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
